newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products climb in wake of futures, crude.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products climb in wake of futures, crude.

text.p: NWE oil products were firmer on Tuesday as crude pushed up the market, traders said.
NWE gasoline gained nearly $2 a tonne after clambering some $4 higher on Monday. Rotterdam barges traded at $195 and $195.50 for prompt to early May loadings.
Gas oil was pulled $1 higher on the back of futures. Premiums were steady for most grades, with barge premiums up to 25 cents stronger.
High sulphur fuel barges were $2 stronger on bidding by one or two players. Physical prices were reluctant to follow cargo swaps up to where they had been pushed by firmer Brent futures.
